President Donald Trump’s job approval rating – 34% as of mid-July – has changed little over the last few months. But it is lower than his rating at a comparable point in his first term – 40% in August 2018 – and those of most other recent presidents at similar stages in their tenures.

results.content: Trump has traditionally seen universal approval among self-identified Republicans, though in this poll there is some minor attrition among his own party (12% disapprove). However, the heart of his current job approval woes is Trump’s standing with Independents, 70% of which disapprove of the job he’s doing – with strong disapproval reaching 65%.
